How to play: Pick a tower, click open ground to place it. Click a placed tower to upgrade or sell it, or drag it to a new tile to reposition it (each tower can be moved 3 times). Right-click or Esc cancels. Hotkeys: Space start wave, Z Zastrow Strike, 1-9 quick pick. Enemies gain a level (I–VIII) every few waves — higher level means more health, speed and armor, but bigger payouts. Zastrow is locked until wave 10 and costs 2500g, so bank your gold. Use Maps to switch game mode, map or route variation — Endless has no finish line.
